families.name: Amplatzer Amulet

families.description: CE-marked direct annuloplasty system for mitral and (later) tricuspid use; no US PMA/IDE approval identified.
families.name: Cardioband

families.description: Single implant family; the 2022 supplement changed labeled indication only, not device design.
families.name: CardioMEMS

families.description: PA pressure sensor system paired with the Cordella HF home-monitoring platform.
families.name: Cordella

families.description: Balloon-expandable stainless-steel coronary sinus reducer, originally developed by Neovasc.
families.name: Coronary Sinus Reducer

families.description: Fixed 8 mm orifice interatrial shunt, formerly marketed as the IASD System II.
families.name: Corvia Atrial Shunt

families.description: SGLT2 inhibitor; the original 2020 HFrEF indication was broadened in 2023 to heart failure across the full range of LVEF.
families.name: Dapagliflozin

families.description: Patient-specific simulation for aortic valve planning.
families.name: PrecisionTAVI

families.description: Surgical LAA exclusion clip (510(k), not a transcatheter occluder); do not merge its attributes with percutaneous LAAO devices.
families.name: Ecliptis

families.description: Left atrium-to-coronary-sinus shunt, distinct mechanism from transseptal interatrial shunts.
families.name: APTURE Transcatheter Shunt System

families.description: SGLT2 inhibitor; the 2021 HFrEF indication was broadened in 2022 to heart failure regardless of ejection fraction.
families.name: Empagliflozin

families.description: Frame access features and redo-TAVR labeling are distinct developments.
families.name: Evolut

families.description: A 56-mm valve was used late in the TRISCEND II trial but is outside the original PMA scope.
families.name: EVOQUE

families.description: Patient-specific simulation for LAA occluder planning.
families.name: FEops HEARTguide

families.description: Nonsteroidal MRA; the HF (LVEF >=40%) indication is a 2025 supplement to the original CKD-in-T2D approval.
families.name: Finerenone

families.description: IVC-area sensor, renamed from the FIRE1 System to the NORM System during clinical development.
families.name: FIRE1 NORM System

families.description: Shared CARDIOFORM platform; the Septal Occluder (<=17 mm, ASD+PFO) and the larger ASD Occluder (8-35 mm, ASD only) are separate labeled configurations under PMA P050006.
families.name: GORE CARDIOFORM

families.description: Self-expanding nitinol platform sized for the native/surgically-repaired RVOT and main pulmonary artery, distinct from Melody's conduit-only indication.
families.name: Harmony

families.description: A blood-pressure management program; no structural-heart efficacy attribution.
families.name: Hello Heart

families.description: Investigational; the transapical (APOLLO) and newer transfemoral transseptal delivery generations should be tracked separately as evidence accrues.
families.name: Intrepid

families.description: CE-marked/China NMPA-approved LAA occluder; track separately from its US IDE-only status.
families.name: LAmbre

families.description: First-in-class cardiac myosin inhibitor for symptomatic obstructive HCM; a supplemental adolescent indication was under FDA priority review as of this extraction.
families.name: Mavacamten

families.description: Bovine-jugular-vein valve for dysfunctional RVOT conduits; converted from a 2010 Humanitarian Device Exemption to a full 2015 PMA approval for the same conduit population.
families.name: Melody

families.description: One indication decision can cover more than one delivery-system generation.
families.name: MitraClip

families.description: Built on the Portico (P190023) delivery/frame platform; the Navitor trade name and NaviSeal outer sealing cuff were introduced by a 2023 design-change supplement, not a fresh original PMA.
families.name: Navitor

families.description: Cardiac myosin activator for HFrEF; the NDA received a 2023 Complete Response Letter and Cytokinetics has stated it has no plans for an additional trial.
families.name: Omecamtiv Mecarbil

families.description: PASCAL and the narrower-profile PASCAL Ace are a single FDA-cleared system, not separate product generations.
families.name: PASCAL

families.description: IV siRNA approved only for hATTR polyneuropathy; the ATTR-CM supplemental indication was not approved (2023 Complete Response Letter).
families.name: Patisiran

families.description: ARNI; the 2015 chronic-HF indication was relabeled in 2021 to remove the "reduced ejection fraction" qualifier, extending use toward HFpEF.
families.name: Sacubitril/Valsartan

families.description: Separate native-valve indication changes from valve design and tissue changes.
families.name: SAPIEN

families.description: Distinct dock-plus-balloon-expandable-valve platform from the aortic SAPIEN family; track the dock and valve as one system.
families.name: SAPIEN M3

families.description: A clinician and coach supported care program, with software as one component.
families.name: Story Health

families.description: TTR stabilizer marketed as two non-interchangeable oral products (Vyndaqel 80 mg, Vyndamax 61 mg) sharing one ATTR-CM indication.
families.name: Tafamidis

families.description: FDA approval is scoped to severe mitral annular calcification (MAC); broader CE-marked MR use is a separate regulatory scope.
families.name: Tendyne

families.description: Trial family mapping does not establish use of the currently labeled generation.
families.name: TriClip

families.description: Anatomically-aligned leaflet Locators anchor the frame without relying on annular calcium, the mechanism behind the first FDA approval for native aortic regurgitation.
families.name: Trilogy

families.description: Soluble guanylate cyclase stimulator for worsening chronic HFrEF.
families.name: Vericiguat

families.description: Leadless transseptal left-atrial pressure sensor, successor to the earlier lead-based HeartPOD concept.
families.name: V-LAP

families.description: GalNAc-conjugated siRNA; the ATTR-CM indication is a 2025 supplement to the 2022 hATTR-polyneuropathy approval.
families.name: Vutrisiran

families.description: Second-generation valveless hourglass shunt; distinguished from the discontinued first-generation valved device.
families.name: Ventura Interatrial Shunt

families.description: Track implant generations, post-implant drug regimens, and post-ablation eligibility separately.
families.name: WATCHMAN
